title: Fear Itself
description:
S01 E04 — In Sickness and in Health
A bride receives a mysterious note on her wedding day, warning her that she is about to wed a serial killer.

title: Fear Itself
description:
September Build
A family man is in a bad accident; as he hovers between life and death, the guy in the bed next to him, a serial killer, switches bodies with him.

title: Uninvited
description: Spring-break teens and an escaped laboratory mutant cat board a yacht with a financier and his henchmen.

title: Grizzly
description: A bloodthirsty grizzly bear stalks two estranged brothers (James Marsden, Thomas Jane) in the Alaskan wilderness.

title: Creepshow III
description: Ghoulish stories revolve around a remote control, a strange radio, a murderous call-girl, an engagement and a ghost.

title: Masters of Horror
description:
S02 E11 — Black Cat
A black cat torments Edgar Allan Poe.

title: Masters of Horror
description:
S01 E12 — Haeckel's Tale
A man traveling to visit his sick father is forced to seek shelter with an elderly man and his young wife, and he soon discovers their terrible secret.

title: Night Screams
description: David is a high school football hero whose parents have announced that they're going away for the weekend, which to David means it's time for a party; however, two killers escape from a nearby jail and crash the party.

title: Summer of 84
description: Teenager Davey Armstrong is a conspiracy theorist who begins to suspect that a neighboring police officer is a serial killer. With help from three friends, Davey launches a daring investigation that soon turns dangerous.

title: Prom Night II: Hello Mary Lou
description: Decades after promiscuous teen Mary Lou Maloney dies during a prank gone wrong, she returns as a spirit out for revenge and eager to punish the culprit, her one-time boyfriend, Billy Nordham, who is now high-school principal.

title: Deadcon
description: A group of young celebrities must unravel the mystery behind a vengeful spirit at the biggest digital event of the year, Viewcon.

title: Black Christmas
description: Sorority sisters (Olivia Hussey, Margot Kidder) and their drunken housemother fall prey to an obscene yuletide caller.

title: Sweet 16
description: Murder and mayhem seem to surround the new girl (Aleisa Shirley) in town as her 16th birthday approaches.

title: Wolf Creek
description:
S02 E06 — Return
Rebecca and Brian navigate their way to Mick's lair; Rebecca goes in search of Danny and manages to find him and Kelly hurt, but still alive; arriving at the lair with an almost catatonic Nina, Mick gets ready for a fight.

title: Wolf Creek
description:
S01 E01 — Billabong
In the Australian Outback, an American family's vacation takes a nightmarish turn when they meet a local man named Mick Taylor.

title: Piranha
description: Two people (Bradford Dillman, Heather Menzies) unwittingly free a mad military scientist's (Kevin McCarthy) mutant fish near a summer camp and resort lake.

title: Fear Itself
description:
S01 E02 — Spooked
A private eye has to face his demons while on a stakeout in a haunted house.

title: Fear Itself
description:
S01 E13 — The Circle
People who meet each Halloween to tell horror stories suddenly realize they are living one.

title: Bloodsucking Bastards
description: An office worker (Fran Kranz) springs into action after learning that his colleague (Pedro Pascal) is a scheming vampire.

title: Mortuary
description: A girl (Mary McDonough) and her boyfriend (David Wallace) suspect her mother (Lynda Day George) and an undertaker are embalming people too soon.

title: The Nest
description: A scientist, a sheriff, an exterminator and an island mayor's daughter go on the hunt for mutant meat-eating cockroaches that are terrorizing a peaceful New England fishing village.

title: Rabid
description: Surgery leaves a Montreal motorcyclist (Marilyn Chambers) with a bloodsucking appendage in her armpit.

title: Masters of Horror
description:
S02 E03 — The V Word
Two teenage boys break into a mortuary to see dead bodies, but what they find is more than they bargained for.

title: Masters of Horror
description:
S02 E07 — Screwfly Solution
A deadly virus infects men across the country, and it could mean the end of mankind, since it causes men to kill every woman they see.

title: Grave Encounters
description: The crew of a ghost-hunting TV show goes insane after being locked in an abandoned psychiatric hospital.

title: Hell House LLC
description: A documentary crew visits Hell House to investigate what really happened 5 years earlier, when 15 people were killed during a haunted house tour.

title: Carnival of Souls
description: After taking a job as a church organist, the sole survivor of a fatal car crash encounters phantoms that lure her to a deserted carnival outside of town.

title: Creepshow III
description: Ghoulish stories revolve around a remote control, a strange radio, a murderous call-girl, an engagement and a ghost.

title: The Taking of Deborah Logan
description: Mia records the daily lives of Deborah and her daughter Sarah as part of her thesis. As the days progress, strange things happen around Deborah, and it becomes apparent something has taken control of her.

title: Demonic Toys
description: Two gunrunners and a pregnant policewoman (Tracy Scoggins) are trapped in a warehouse with a bad boy's toys.

title: The Exorcist III
description: A police detective (George C. Scott) investigates a series of slayings done in the style of an executed killer (Brad Dourif).

title: Nightbreed
description: A young man's quest to end his nightmares leads him to a cemetery where monsters have retreated to escape mankind.

title: Silent Hill: Revelation
description: When her adoptive father disappears, Sharon Da Silva is drawn into a strange and terrifying alternate reality that holds answers to the horrific nightmares that have plagued her since childhood.

title: 50 States of Fright
description:
S01 E01 — The Golden Arm (Michigan) -- Part 1
Heather offers Dave a helping hand, but she may never see that hand again.

title: 50 States of Fright
description:
S01 E02 — The Golden Arm (Michigan) -- Part 2
Obsessed with her beauty, Heather insists on an arm replacement made of gold, but it comes at a cost.

title: 50 States of Fright
description:

Dave goes against Heather's last wish to get out of debt, but when someone breaks a promise, the fallout can be deadly.

description:

An American lawyer working in Tokyo goes on a weekend trip with a client and his wife.
